verdicts.reason: A breaks the product hero: the teal circle has slid down to the bottom-left and is detached from the can, so it reads as a stray blob with the can floating above it and a dead strip along the bottom. B keeps the can centred on its circle the way the original does, but the circle's right edge nearly touches the 'Mint' headline. Both share the same flaw in the right column: the headline starts at about x385 while GLACIER, the body copy, the badges and the CTA start at about x408, so the left edge is ragged.
